verdict.rationale: WorkOS is API-first, so it can be driven headlessly. Evidence shows an official Node SDK with automatic retry and backoff, a published OpenAPI spec, configuration of roles and permissions via API rather than only the Dashboard, and a WorkOS CLI migrations tool for exporting Auth0 data. Together these support scripted, non-interactive automation, but nothing shows CI usage explicitly. Missing for 10: CI-specific documentation or examples (e.g. API-key handling in pipelines), a general-purpose management CLI beyond migrations, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless or CI use.
